description_en: Queries the health check information for a virtual border router (VBR) in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域内边界路由器（VBR）健康检查信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-cen-vbr-health-check --cen-id cen-6hpdgj7ni6pz1k0000 --vbr-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-instance-id vbr-bp1kznorjeembsuhl0000 --vbr-instance-owner-id 1250123456123456 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCenVbrHealthCheck

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Virtual Border Router (VBR) is deployed.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html
parameters.help_zh:
VBR实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: vbr_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VBR
parameters.help_zh: VBR实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: vbr_instance_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

VbrHealthCheck.description_en: The health check configurations of the VBR
VbrHealthCheck.description_zh: VBR实例的健康检查配置信息

Description.description_en: The description of the health check

HealthCheckInterval.description_en: The interval, in seconds, at which probe packets are sent during a health check
HealthCheckInterval.description_zh: 健康检查发送连续探测报文的时间间隔。单位：秒

HealthCheckOnly.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable the detection-only feature for the health check.

true: The system detects the link status but does not switch routes if the health check fails.

  ```
    If this feature is enabled, the system detects the link status but does not switch routes when the health check fails.
  ```

false: If a redundant route is available in the CEN instance, the system switches to the redundant route if the health check fails.

  ```
    If this feature is disabled and a redundant route is available in the CEN instance, the system switches to the redundant route when the health check fails.
  ```
HealthCheckOnly.description_zh:
是否只开启了健康检查的检测功能。

true：是。

        若只开启健康检查的检测功能，健康检查检测到链路不通时不会触发路由切换。

false：否。

        若未开启本功能，健康检查检测到链路不通时，如果云企业网实例中存在冗余的路由，健康检查会立刻触发路由切换使用可用链路

HealthCheckSourceIp.description_en: The source IP address of the health check

HealthCheckTargetIp.description_en: The destination IP address of the health check

HealthyThreshold.description_en: The number of probe packets that are sent during a health check
HealthyThreshold.description_zh: 健康检查发送探测报文的个数

VbrInstanceRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the VBR is deployed
